description: Approval Policy entity: what approval must consist of for an opportunity pattern and resource selector (PRD cpt-cf-approval-service-fr-approval-policies). Every applicable policy of the subject tenant and its ancestors must be satisfied (logical AND). Requirements are expressed as ordered stages: a p1 policy has exactly one stage; staged policies with several stages are p2 (PRD cpt-cf-approval-service-fr-staged-policies). Policies come from the 'runtime' layer (any tenant) or the 'configuration' layer (root tenant, read-only through the API). This type is the subject type of policy change events (DESIGN cpt-cf-approval-service-entity-policy).

id.description: Policy identifier. UUID for runtime policies; a stable synthetic identifier for configuration policies.

resource_selector.description: Exactly one of a projection type pattern or one specific projection.

condition.description: Optional CEL condition over opportunity, subject, projection, and context attributes (p2, PRD cpt-cf-approval-service-fr-conditional-policies). The policy applies only when it evaluates to true; an evaluation failure means not applicable.

stages.description: Ordered approval stages. Exactly one in p1. An approve decision counts toward a stage only if recorded after the previous stage was satisfied.

max_lease_secs.description: Optional maximum approval lease for verdicts this policy applies to; never above the configured maximum (PRD cpt-cf-approval-service-fr-approval-lease).

forbid_auto_approval.description: When true, only human approvals satisfy this policy (p2, PRD cpt-cf-approval-service-fr-auto-approval).

escalation_recipients.description: Users or groups named in request-escalated events while this policy is unmet (p2, PRD cpt-cf-approval-service-fr-request-escalation). Naming a recipient grants nothing.

version.description: Policy version, incremented on every change; fixed into request policy snapshots (p2, PRD cpt-cf-approval-service-fr-policy-snapshot).

min_approvals.description: Minimum number of distinct counting approvers.

mandatory_approvers.description: Approvers who must all approve. Users in p1; groups from the Group Source in p2, satisfied by one member's approval.

approvers.description: Optional narrowed approver list. Absent: every holder of the approve permission counts. Present: only listed approvers count.

kind.description: 'user' (p1) or 'group' (p2). Enum evolution: new kinds only in a new major.
